commands.label: winlogic-encrypted-backup-D-E
commands.note: Kill any 7z, then archive C:\Users\endos\Signal (skip hst_out) to Desktop, copy to D: and E:. No compression (-mx=0), AES256 encrypted, encrypt headers. Report file sizes.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "taskkill /f /im 7z.exe 2>$null; $sz = if (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe') {'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe'} else {'C:\Program Files (x86)\7-Zip\7z.exe'}; $out = 'C:\Users\endos\Desktop\WinLogic_backup.7z'; & $sz a -mx=0 -mhe=on -pSc0rp!0n $out 'C:\Users\endos\Signal' -x!'C:\Users\endos\Signal\hst_out' -x!'C:\Users\endos\Signal\data\history' 2>&1 | Out-File 'C:\Users\endos\Desktop\wl_backup_log.txt'; Copy-Item $out 'D:\WinLogic_backup.7z' -Force; Copy-Item $out 'E:\WinLogic_backup.7z' -Force; $d=(Get-Item 'D:\WinLogic_backup.7z').length; $e=(Get-Item 'E:\WinLogic_backup.7z').length; "D:$d E:$e" | Out-File 'C:\Users\endos\Desktop\wl_backup_sizes.txt'"
